decisions.note: Locator 47:113001211 is verified as JP 霞薙ぐ花形. The title is compact and poetic, with 花形 meaning a star/leading figure and 霞薙ぐ carrying an image not mirrored literally by the Chinese bridge; defer for literary style review.
